chronoseries.note: Singleton extant tip. No fossil chronospecies is parameterized in this slot. The comparison is across scale, not across geological age.

equations.kinetics: Schnakenberg 1979: du/dt = a - u + u^2 v + Du lap u; dv/dt = b - u^2 v + Dv lap v
equations.dispersion: sigma(k) = larger real part of eig(J - k^2 diag(Du, Dv))
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (Dv f_u + Du g_v) / (2 Du Dv); lambda_c = 2 pi / k_c
equations.boundary_condition: periodic on a square lamina patch (eigenbasis of the Laplacian). No-flux leaf margins are not the simulated boundary.

parameters.note: Slot-specific basal rates. They are not a published Cornus fit and they are not the textbook Schnakenberg pair a=0.10, b=0.90.

empirical_claims: Turing 1952: a homogeneous chemical state can be unstable to a finite band of wavenumbers when the inhibitor diffuses sufficiently faster than the activator, selecting lambda = 2 pi / k_c.
Schnakenberg 1979 supplies the two-species kinetics used to instantiate that band. This paper does not mention Cornus.
Xiang et al. 2006 place Cornus controversa inside extant Cornus. This slot's chronoseries is the Holocene tip only (0 Ma).
Feng, Xiang and Franks 2011 reconstruct developmental changes in Cornus inflorescences. That is a different organ and a different law from a 1.939 mm lamina wavenumber.
Vareed et al. 2006 measured anthocyanins in C. controversa fruit. Fruit pigment chemistry is not a leaf wavelength.
The cultivar margin of 'Variegata' is a periclinal chimera. It is not claimed here as a Turing pattern.
